verdict.rationale: Intel's own AI stack documents support for this silicon class. oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations target Core Ultra series 2 and Arc GPUs, OpenVINO documents an NPU inference device for Core Ultra processors, and VTune adds client GPU/NPU analysis. That satisfies the story's 'vendor's own AI software stack' option. Missing for 10: any evidence that third-party runtimes (llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime) support it, documentation tied to the 258V/Lunar Lake specifically rather than Core Ultra broadly, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
